name: Yamagata (Nagano, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Yamagata village emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears crossed by a diagonal stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Yamagata, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 January 1972.

features.role: Yamagata village emblem — a ring with two pointed ears crossed by a diagonal stroke
